dedupe_keys.name: iata world air transport statistics wats

description: World Air Transport Statistics (WATS) is IATA's global aviation statistics database built from data that more than 250 international airlines report directly each year. It covers passenger volumes, cargo metrics, financial results, fleet data and employee headcount in five domains, with traffic, fleet, financial, ranking and safety datasets. Demand indicators include revenue passengers and revenue passenger-kilometres by region, route area and airline type, passenger load factor, cargo and available cargo tonne-kilometres, freight tonnes and cargo and weight load factors. It is produced and validated by IATA and delivered through an interactive dashboard. Coverage is global. Access is paid by subscription, with standard subscriptions including 16 years of historical data and records back to 1945 on request, and a demo can be requested; a data overview is available to download. Caveats: it reflects what member and reporting airlines submit, so non-reporting carriers are missing, and the licence terms are commercial. It supports demand and capacity planning of air transport, economic analysis of disruptions and baselines for recovery after shocks. It complements the ACI World airport traffic statistics and is related to the Eurocontrol Aviation Intelligence Portal.
